title: Contains Duplicate
prompt: Given an integer array `nums`, return `True` if any value appears at least twice, and `False` if every element is distinct.
hints: A hash set lets you check membership in O(1) as you scan once.
Add each number to a set; if a number is already in the set, you've found a duplicate.
Alternatively, compare len(set(nums)) to len(nums), though that's less useful to discuss for early exit.
